def execute_zilean_chronoshift_league(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Places a protective temporal effect on an ally that resurrects them if they would die during its duration.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    death_record = lookup_recent_or_bound_death_record(target)
    if not meets_revival_predicates(actor, death_record): return DENIED
    body = respawn_or_reanimate_from_record(death_record)
    restore_permitted_health_memory_and_form_fields(body)
    mark_death_record_revived_to_block_duplicate_resurrections()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
